messages:
marco: kicking off catalog enable for cerberus-v2 now. canary=5% region=eu-west-1. fallback order proposed: cerberus-v1 -> cerberus-v2-quant -> lite-cerberus. change window 15m, SLO target p95<=200ms. watch /eng-sre and oncall. release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/cerberus-v2

deploy-bot: Rollout started: catalog.enable cerberus-v2 canary=5% regions=[eu-west-1] id=roll-3698765432

elly: noted. i'll wire up the dashboard alerts — guardband +15% latency and error threshold 0.5%. monitoring dashboards: /dashboards/cerberus-v2-canary

sre-jen: oncall ACK. will pause at 10m if errors spike. ping me @here for rollback decision.

li: pinned cerberus:v2-2026-03-20 to catalog mapping. pin TTL=48h, auto-unpin=false. leaving v1 mapping for fallback.

marco: thanks. pin TTL good. proceed with observability hooks.

audrey: small note — quant variant underperforms on long-context tests in qa. recommend fallback priority be v1 -> v2-nonquant -> v2-quant -> lite.

elly: updated fallback ordering in rollout config (pushed). also added a canary-check job that fails on error_rate>0.5% over 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics t+5m: requests=12k, errors=0.12%, p95=190ms, rps stable. No action.

marco: good. tagging eng-ml for any model-side concerns.

deploy-bot: Canary t+12m: errors increased to 0.9% (threshold breached). Rolling canary back to 0% and pausing cutover. Action logged: roll-3698765432 -> paused.

marco: acknowledged. can someone grab traces / sample logs for the error class? cc @eng-ml @li

li: grabbing traces now. initial look: KV cache miss spike + OOMs on the quant execution path under bursty long-contexts. looks like quant kernel memory pressure.

marco: OK. change plan: revert canary to 0% (done), disable quant variant for canary, re-run canary with cerberus:v2-nonquant at 5% in eu-west-1. extend guardband to 30m for this rerun. proceed? :thinking_face:

sre-jen: proceed but keep rollback trigger at errors>0.5% sustained for 10m. i'll be watching and will call rollback if needed.

elly: updating release notes and telemetry. PR for non-quant variant rollout is up: https://git.redwood/release/cerberus-v2-nonquant

deploy-bot: Canary re-run triggered: model=cerberus:v2-nonquant canary=5% region=eu-west-1 id=roll-3698765432-b

deploy-bot: t+6m (rerun): metrics: errors=0.08%, p95=198ms, rps normal. stable.

marco: looks stable. plan: after 30m stable -> promote to 25%, after +2h -> 100% if green. logging schedule in release notes.

audrey: noted — also update cost-per-token and quant recommendations in the notes (quant disabled for canary).

li: disabling auto-quant suggestions for this model until we do a deeper postmortem. will collect allocation traces.

elly: rollback runbook snippet for quick ops: `deploybot rollback roll-3698765432 --to=cerberus:v1` and `deploybot pause roll-3698765432`

deploy-bot: deploy timeline updated. next promotion scheduled at t+30m.

sre-jen: monitoring in place. will page if error_rate>0.5% for 10m window. reach me oncall.

marco: thanks all. tagging @eng-releases for visibility. short postmortem if we hit another regression. :thumbsup:
